Seems to be a variant of HPND with the trademark and training additions.
+1 to add as new license and I don't think I'd use "HPND" in the id since it adds a whole new clause. Since it is Adobe specific, I think it's ok to use that name though

> +1 to add as a new license, this one is also found on the old Xfree86 website at https://www.xfree86.org/4.0/LICENSE3.html (section 3.8).

ftr, that's the same source package, since the matching code pre-dates the xfree86-xorg split, that license will be in any X server fork.

> This license appears to be tied specifically to Adobe's Display PostScript code,

There is only one file in the X server that uses this license ([dix/dixutils.c](https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/xorg/xserver/-/blob/master/dix/dixutils.c)) and it doesn't seem to have any obvious post script code. Figuring out more details here is a question for people willing to wear topees :)

>  but do you think Adobe-Display-PostScript as an ID and "Adobe Display PostScript License" as a name would be accurate(ish) here?

Yes, I think that's good enough. There is no other instance of this license in my local copy of the various xorg repositories.
